authorization.scope: Accepts the preceding preserved MXF Effect output contract and asks for the next requirements-review topic. No new source priorities, parser implementation or cutover are approved.

agreedBellaRules.inputs: Final selected independently established Precompute Type and decoded Clip Name from the agreed qualified master. Supported MXF Name decoding already agreed as UTF-16BE.
agreedBellaRules.known: First matching canonical English Effect name from existing shared AvidEffects::lookup, including recognized localized or explicit compatibility aliases.
agreedBellaRules.unrecognized: Nonempty extracted token preserved verbatim, including case, underscores, whitespace and spelling. Unknown Effect Category does not erase Effect text.
agreedBellaRules.unavailable: Empty/unavailable Effect on Precompute displays lowercase unknown. Ordinary Media/unknown Type blank. No change to independent Type or Precompute Category.
agreedBellaRules.parserContract: Preserve exact suffix validation and precedence, sequence commas, malformed/overflow suffix text, case rules, aliases and existing first-name selection for category ambiguity.
agreedBellaRules.retention: Keep owned QString Effect and Effect Category results from the same combined lookup. Reuse associated master/name results during processing, derive again after selected inputs change. Do not retain Effect Sequence or a permanent all-name cache.
agreedBellaRules.readScope: No separate Effect decoder, effect graph, plug-in load or additional source/header read solely for this value. Cross-source priorities remain separate.
agreedBellaRules.identityLimit: Editable-name recognition does not establish the original generating effect identity or live plug-in variant. Native registered names use actual effect-object identifiers.
agreedBellaRules.implementation: Small fresh adapter around existing standalone catalogue/resolver and C++17/Qt6.5.3 values; no measured performance improvement or new framework.

priorCapturedNameProof.use: Previously verified own-master Name/Type inputs, exact copied-header field ranges and source-derived catalogue observer; current source hashes and 22 copied-header/object hashes rechecked.
